<description>
Some misc CI config cleanups:

* Mainly, to derive the unique CONTAINER_NAME from the unique file name.
* Two refactors, to remove redundant stuff.
</description>

<commits>
fa8fd9164f ci: Derive CONTAINER_NAME from the ci config file name

CONTAINER_NAME needs to be set and needs to be unique. Both can be
ensured by using the file name.

fa547e8204 ci: [refactor] Remove redundant set -o errexit

It is already set by the source`d script.

fa2cdb6a3c ci: [refactor] remove redundant GOAL=install

The default already is GOAL=install, so it seems fine to rely on it.
</commits>
